India Finishes Fourth at Asian Games After Late Gold Medal Surge

India secured fourth place at the Asian Games following a significant surge in gold medals during the final days of the competition. For 12 days, India had accumulated 10 gold medals, but a late rush saw them win six gold medals on Friday and five more on Saturday. Teen archer Kumkum Mohod made history by winning India's first women's individual recurve gold medal, and golfer Pranavi also achieved a historic feat.
